candidates.change_summary: Change `msg.sender` to `address(0)` in constructor argument, so newOracle has owner zero instead of msg.sender.
Change description argument to an empty string literal, so newOracle stores different description.
Replace `new EmergencyOracle(...)` with a different contract creation, so returned newOracle address differs.
Move `emit NewEmergencyOracle(...)` before contract creation, so emitted newOracle is zero instead of created address.
Remove the `onlyJojoTeam` modifier, allowing anyone to call and change newOracle address.
Replace `jojoTeam` with `address(0)` in require check, so modifier always reverts and newEmergencyOracle can never succeed.
Delete the require statement, so modifier passes for any caller and newOracle becomes callable by anyone.
